Acme Synthetic Compliance Policy v1.0

Section 1 — Access Control
All employees must use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access production systems. Access reviews must be performed quarterly by the system owner. Dormant accounts inactive for more than 30 days must be disabled.

Section 2 — Data Retention
Customer data must be retained for no longer than 7 years and then securely deleted. Backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256. Personal data must not be stored on personal devices.

Section 3 — Incident Response
Security incidents must be reported to the security team within 24 hours of discovery. The incident response plan must be tested at least annually.

Section 4 — Vendor Management
All vendors with access to customer data must sign a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) before onboarding. Vendor security assessments are renewed every 12 months.

Section 5 — Password Policy
Passwords must be at least 12 characters and rotated every 90 days. Passwords must not be reused across systems.
